name: flowtrace
description: Plan a change before any code, well enough to steer it, and explain one to someone who has never seen it. plan-flows reads the code the change touches, researches how it is best done, and draws the plan as a storyboard: every step in order, each with a picture, the gist, how it works and the trade-off made there; during the build the page shows each step's result beside what was promised. plan-check then questions the approved plan; explain teaches how something works or asks you to choose, with one worked example traced through today and after.

interface.shortDescription: Plan a change before any code, explain how code works
interface.longDescription: plan-flows reads the code a change touches (the functions it edits, what calls them and the tests that run them), researches how it is best done, and draws the plan as a storyboard: every step in order, each with a picture, the gist, how it works and the trade-off made there. It asks only what you alone can decide, at the step each question belongs to, and during the build shows each step's result beside what the plan promised. plan-check then has a fresh subagent look for the edge cases and gaps the approved plan leaves, and asks you each one. explain teaches how something works or asks you to choose, with one worked example traced through today and after, and has a fresh subagent read the page cold. No skill commits or switches branches.
defaultPrompt: Plan this change with plan-flows before writing any code.
Run plan-check on the approved plan.
Explain how this works with explain.
